description: Edit: turns a magenta (255,0,255) scribble 3-7 px wide on a photo into the described object. Prompt '<doodle> Turn the magenta scribble into {caption}.'; 40 steps, cfg 1. Best stacked with viggle-turbo (both 1.0, 6 steps) - alone it only matches the base. Use this gate_up-split file: the repo's other files keep img_mlp.gate_up fused, which diffusers drops
use_when: Add an object to a photo where a magenta scribble is drawn
